effective_text_prompt: Describe with a paragraph what is shown in the image.
content: </s><s>The image shows an empty office space with a man sitting at a desk in front of a computer. He is wearing a pink shirt and a black cap and is sitting on a black office chair. The desk is covered with a gray deskcloth and there is a white fan on the left side of the desk. On the right side, there are two white boxes and a cardboard box on the floor. The walls are painted white and there are a few windows in the background. The floor is made of light-colored tiles.</s>
